node.title: Re^10: Easiest way to filter a file based on user input
node.author: Peter Keystrokes
node.doctext:
Oh okay, apologies for the buffoonery on my part.

The script seems to be working fine now, I added another next line: next if /^(\s\s-\d)/ && $1 > $limit;, because without it, it doesn't recognise regular Real numbers like -2, -5 etc.

The script:

#!/usr/bin/perl use strict; use warnings; use Regexp::Common qw /number/; print "Enter limit: "; chomp( my $limit = ); #$limit = abs($limit); open my $IN, '<', "xt_spacer_results.hairpin" or die $!; open my $SIFTED, '>', "new_xt_spacer_results.hairpin" or die $!; while (<$IN>){ next if /^None/; next if /^($RE{num}{real})/ && $1 > $limit; next if /^(\s\s-\d)/ && $1 > $limit; print $SIFTED $_; } close $IN; close $SIFTED;

Haukex, you are a legend, thanks.
